scope: Focused static review of the R12 R4 executor's source-successor validation, R11 metadata/package bindings, cache/warm-target receipts, and no-launch preflight. No Cargo, Nextest, tests, or launch.

review.source_successor_chain: The executor separately opens and hash-pins the original R11 proposal and source review, corrected R12 proposal, digest erratum, and READY digest review. It preserves the original 4f832… digest, verifies the R11 source-review bindings against that original proposal, normalizes only successor.package_digest, then checks the corrected proposal and digest-review rows against the corrected value.
review.package: The preflight snapshot records the R11 package root, ten file rows, unchanged lock SHA a80325ff…a586c1f, and corrected length-prefixed package digest ed1bbc08f867d4409dd71deb3fe81e398e725eaad04ab451c1261693416c57d0. This digest was independently recomputed in the bound digest review.
review.metadata: The invocation reuses R11 metadata result/stdout/stderr and R11 package root. Executor checks locked/offline/all-features metadata result, lock before/after, package count 41, and workspace_root equal to the R11 package root; no tests are represented as having run.
review.cache_and_target: Runtime Cargo cache receipt binds 85 private copied files, 40 archives, 44 sparse index records, R6 source receipt and R4 preparation receipt. Warm-target receipt binds the R10 source snapshot copied into the fresh R12 target root and checks exact file/directory identities before launch.
review.no_launch_state: Invocation and grant template both say PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORIZED / PENDING_ROOT_DECISION with execution_authorized=false. Supplied preflight is PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_CARGO_NO_TEST, authorized=false, and records only read-only inventories; runtime directory has no launch logs/result/report.
review.limits: This review accepts the static binding/preflight contract only. It does not authorize the ignored Rust test or claim historical R11 cache-source audit success.
